{{Quote|These slaves never learn their lesson! Yusinduu will pay me tripple for this!|Griknaz duels the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Sa'har Kateen]]|<ref name="TPB" />}}
'''Griknaz''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. A former Arena Champion,<ref name="Champion">{{TORcite|Griknaz Ability: "Arena Champion Signature Move..."}}</ref> with the unique ability to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] clearly and fluently, he later acted as the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Refinery Security Force]] members serving [[Vobbara Yusinduu]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]]. Griknaz was leading his forces against a slave uprising against Yusinduu when he was confronted by the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Sa'har Kateen]]. Under the watch of his [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] employer, Griknaz duelled the two, and quickly realized they were independent agents. He was ultimately overwhelmed and left wounded, to which the two interrogated him for the location of a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] belonging to the [[Hidden Chain]]. Before he could say a word, one of Yusinduu's men gunned down the Captain on the Hutt's orders.<ref name="TPB" />
